title: mAI Priority

title: engineering-team
description: A full-lifecycle engineering team with tool-backed security audits, EU-regulation aware, environment setup, context reuse, recorded handovers and a local visual workspace for any project.

title: phaser4-gamedev
description: A Claude Code plugin that makes building Phaser 4 web games fast and easy. It ships 4 specialized agents and 6 slash-command skills that encode deep Phaser 4 knowledge - so you can build any 2D web game without needing to memorize the API.

title: Ember Citadel
description: Ember Citadel: a browser action RPG where you explore a procedural world by day, build a fortified citadel with your embers, and survive horde nights and boss fights with parry-and-dodge combat. Built in TypeScript with three.js and Rapier physics; runs offline as an installable PWA on desktop and mobile.

title: Stress Relief

title: neural-memory
description: A persistent knowledge graph plugin for Claude Code that maps your codebase into three layers - code, bugs, and tasks - Coding sessions with Claude Code always get deep context without burning tokens re-reading files.
